description: Study values Northeast Swale, Briarwood Park for climate, health.
Northeast Swale offers climate benefits; Briarwood Park offers health savings.
Committee will forward report to Environmental Advisory Committee.

chips.text: Recommended
Briarwood Park's nature access valued over $7,700 per hectare annually.
Native grasslands store carbon underground, not released during fires.
Over 6,400 residents near Northeast Swale access nature; 12,000 by 2050.
Study informs integrating natural assets into city asset management systems.
Northeast Swale sequesters 16 tons carbon per hectare annually.
Administration will explore more natural asset valuations and monitoring.
